project: Classic gunner, shoot fast moving bullets or use your special to spray a stream of 10 bullets.
On using super gain a +75% speed boost for 1.5 seconds
x2 ammo but also x2 reload time
each time you reload also heal an amount directly proportional to your reload speed
every 3 seconds the next time you take damage reload 1 ammo if you are not reloading
every 7 seconds your next attack will also fire a snowball that stuns enemies
for the first 30 seconds of the match take 30% less damage
each last ammo will also shoot a bullet that does damage directly proportional to your total ammo
every 2 seconds your next attack will also fire a magic projectile that will do small damage
every 5 seconds place down a mine
for the first 10 seconds of the match place 1 mine down every second
every 10 seconds your next super will fully reload your ammo
each consecutive super will take 2 less seconds to charge (cannot go below 3 seconds)
leave behind a poisonous trail that damages enemies
every 1 seconds on being hit explode into thorns
gain an orbiting bat which steals health, can hit enemies up to 7 times
gain an orbiting void which can absorb projectiles up to 10 times
gain 2 orbiting voids which can each absorb projectiles up to 4 times
+50 max health x2 shot delay x1.5 reload speed -10% movement speed
every 10 seconds spawn a potion that heals you
Every 5 seconds shoot a knife which will mark opponents for 3 seconds, marked opponents will take bonus damage
Right click map icon to disable it
